title: Tighten the plugin scope token to a leading alphanumeric, and strip Unicode format characters from runtime text (paired with lore-cli, OPAG-453)
description: Ruled by opum-agent 2026-09-26T19:43:37Z as opum-agent OPAG-453: ONE paired change, byte-identical code in quest-cli and lore-cli under ADR ruling (d). quest proposes the exact code and lore-cli agrees it. Ordered after QCLI-380, QCLI-378, QCLI-379 and QCLI-381. Source: the opum-workflow reviewer on opum-ai/quest-cli#290 (QCLI-380). Both findings exist identically in lore-cli dc09ca98. F4, measured on the regex: /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/ accepts a dash-led scope, so a scope of "--scope" produces `claude plugin update opum-quest@opum --scope --scope` in the remedy and the update argv. It has no shell metacharacters; whether claude parser misreads it is unmeasured. Ruled: /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/. F5, measured: printable() passes Unicode format characters, e.g. RLO U+202E, which can visually reorder a printed remedy line, and ZWSP U+200B. Ruled, as NARROWED by opum-agent 2026-09-26T19:48:58Z on lore-cli measurement: one shared helper, no two-mode split. It strips only U+202A-U+202E (bidi embeddings and overrides), U+2066-U+2069 (isolates), U+200B, U+2060 and U+FEFF. It KEEPS U+200C (ZWNJ), U+200D (ZWJ), U+200E (LRM), U+200F (RLM) and U+061C (ALM). lore-cli shares stripAnsiAndControls with document titles and ids, where ZWJ joins emoji sequences and ZWNJ and the marks carry meaning in RTL, Persian and Indic text. F4 is unchanged: lore-cli already ships the tightened token via LCLI-593 (opum-ai/lore-cli#297), so on F4 quest matches that code.

acceptanceCriteria.text: plainScope rejects a scope whose first character is not ASCII alphanumeric, so no remedy or update argv carries a dash-led --scope value; a test pins --scope and -x, and the regex matches lore-cli LCLI-593 (opum-ai/lore-cli#297)

printable removes U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200B, U+2060 and U+FEFF, and KEEPS U+200C, U+200D, U+200E, U+200F and U+061C; a test pins each stripped range, each kept character (including a ZWJ emoji sequence), and that surrounding text survives
The code is byte-identical to lore-cli implementing commit for the same change, agreed with lore-cli before merge and cited with both SHAs and OPAG-453

plan: 1. F4: plainScope regex becomes /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/, lore-cli src/core/agent-plugins.ts:126 (LCLI-593). A dash-led claude scope is then unnamable: prose remedy, no update (QCLI-383).
2. F5: printable gains a third pass after the ANSI and C0/C1 strips with the regex agreed with lore-cli (LCLI-607, #307 at f2d3223c, merged 53d8912d), byte-identical including \\u escapes.

3. Tests: --scope and -x pinned through the CLI; a sweep over U+0600-06FF, U+2000-206F and U+FE00-FEFF asserting the removed set is exactly the 12 code points; kept characters including a ZWJ emoji sequence; U+FEFF pinned at the sanitiser, and at printable as a space, because \\s collapses it first in both CLIs.
4. Mutation-check each; bun run check; send the SHA to lore-cli for LCLI-607.
implementationNotes: AGREED with lore-cli before merge (2026-09-26 cross-session exchange; lore-cli recorded it on LCLI-607 and merged opum-ai/lore-cli#307, f2d3223c, as 53d8912d). BYTE-IDENTICAL, verified against lore-cli 53d8912d by SHA: F5 regex /[‪-‮⁦-⁩​⁠﻿]/g (lore src/errors.ts:206, written with \u escapes) applied as a third pass after the ANSI and C0/C1 strips; F4 regex /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/ (lore src/core/agent-plugins.ts:127). Both live in src/domain/agent-plugins.ts (unicodeFormatForgery, plainScope). A dash-led claude scope is now unnamable, so it gets the QCLI-383 prose remedy and no update. U+FEFF: JS \s matches it, so on printable, in both CLIs, the leading collapse turns it into a space before the format pass runs. Its removal is pinned at the sanitiser constant, and printable is pinned as "a b"; both layers agreed with lore-cli. EVIDENCE: 9 cases, including a sweep over U+0600-06FF, U+2000-206F and U+FE00-FEFF that asserts the removed set is exactly the 12 code points, a ZWJ emoji sequence, and ZWNJ inside Persian text. Mutations each reddened exactly the predicted set: the old token regex reddened 3 (both dash-led CLI cases and the token unit test); dropping the format pass reddened 3 (join, RLO, runtime version), with the sweep and FEFF cases green; widening the class to U+200C-200F reddened 2 (sweep, kept). bun run check exit 0, 731 pass. Cites OPAG-453. The quest implementing SHA is this PR squash commit, sent to lore-cli for LCLI-607 after merge.
finalSummary: OPAG-453 F4 and F5 in one change, paired with lore-cli LCLI-607 (merged 53d8912d) and byte-identical to it. F4: a scope token must start with a letter or digit, so a dash-led value (--scope, -x) never reaches a remedy or the update argv; such a claude scope is unnamable and gets the prose remedy. F5: printable strips U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069, U+200B, U+2060 and U+FEFF, and keeps ZWNJ, ZWJ, LRM, RLM and ALM, so an RLO cannot reorder a printed remedy line. Verified with a code-point sweep, kept-character cases, CLI cases over a logging fake claude, three targeted mutations each reddening exactly the predicted set, and bun run check exit 0 (731 pass).
